categories.title: Save Point
categories.info: Interact with save points to replenish Sora's health, make a manual save, or travel to new worlds.

categories.title: Lucky Emblem
categories.info: Use Sora's camera to reveal a "Hidden Mickey" in the environment. These sneaky collectibles often require creative perspectives to line up all elements of the Lucky Emblem.

categories.title: Photo Mission
categories.info: Go on a photo scavenger hunt using clues from the Moogles. Each completed mission unlocks a new synthesis recipe for the Workshop.

categories.title: Recipe
categories.info:
Cuisine cooked at Little Chef's [Le Grand Bistrot](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-hearts-3/maps/twilight-town?locationIds=386585) in Traverse Town. Play a short cooking minigame to create a consumable item that **temporarily increases stats for the entire team**. All recipes are infinitely repeatable, as long as you have the required ingredients.

Earn ★★★ on the minigame to change meals from their base form to plus (+), further increasing stat bonuses. Consuming a Full Course (starter, soup, fish, meat, and dessert) will grant an additional ability on top of individual dish bonuses.

categories.title: Battlegate
categories.info:
After finishing the main story, return to previous worlds to find new combat scenarios for Sora to face. Interact with the blue spiked orb to start the challenge.

Complete all Battlegates to unlock a secret boss.

categories.title: Classic Kingdom
categories.info:
A trip down memory lane! These mini-games mimic classic Game & Watch handhelds from the 1980's. 

Found by opening chests or examining game posters. Once obtained, they can be played anytime from the Gummiphone menu. Play all Classic Kingdom games at least once to earn the **Classic Tone Keyblade**.

categories.title: Mini-Game
categories.info: Take a break from following your heart's guiding key and play some games!

categories.title: Ingredient
categories.info:
Want to cook meals at Little's Chef's [Le Grand Bistrot](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-hearts-3/maps/twilight-town?locationIds=386585) in Traverse Town? Sora will need ingredients first!

Ingredients can be found by harvesting plants via Command prompts or striking food sources. They will respawn after exiting and re-entering a world.

locations.title: Le Grand Bistrot
locations.description:
Interact with the menu stand to cook dishes with Little Chef.

Requires ingredients collected from various worlds. Check the menu and recipe cards for what is required.

locations.title: Lumpy's Fruit Parade
locations.description:
Lumpy's iteration of the matching game adds a new hazard. Clear the fruit before it falls into the river!

**Rewards:**
- Less than 15,000 = Panacea
- 15,000 - 29,999 = Fruit Ingredients x 3
- 30,000 - 44,999 = Fruit Ingredients x 7
- Greater than 45,000 = Fruit Ingredients x 12

locations.title: Tigger's Vegetable Spree
locations.description:
Tigger's iteration of the matching game adds a time limit and removes the counter limit. Get as many points as possible before time runs out!

**Rewards:**
- Less than 15,000 = Panacea
- 15,000 - 24,999 = Vegetable Ingredients x 3
- 25,000 - 34,999 = Vegetable Ingredients x 7
- Greater than 35,000 = Vegetable Ingredients x 12

locations.title: Pooh's Hunny Harvest
locations.description:
For the third (and final) iteration of the matching game, time can be added by leveling up Pooh's honey pot.

**Rewards:**
- Less than 20,000 = Panacea
- 20,000 - 39,999 = Honey
- 40,000 - 59,999 = Honey x 3
- Greater than 60,000 = Honey x 6

locations.title: Demon Tide
locations.description: The first time Sora visits Twilight Town, a torrent of Heartless will be waiting. The boss will be "defeated" when 15% of its health (approx. 3 bars) is destroyed.

locations.title: 100 Acre Woods
locations.description:
A staple of the Kingdom Hearts series, 100 Acre Woods is an **optional** world only accessible through Winnie the Pooh's storybook in Merlin's possession. 

After completing Arandelle, Merlin will appear in Twilight Town near Le Grand Bistrot. The storybook portal is on the cafe table next to Merlin.

locations.title: Postcard Mail Slot
locations.description: Postcards are awarded with every purchase at Moogle Shops. Submit the postcards via the mail slot to earn loyalty rewards.
